description:
In 1940, amidst an era of chaos, a beautiful mansion named Yeongchunhwa was built on a remote island, constructed solely out of a man's deep love for his wife. Time passed, and the story of the couple tied to the mansion faded from memory. Yet one day, a mysterious ‘caretaker’ appeared, transforming it into a lodging establishment. He began inviting people to the mansion—those who must love, guided by the couple's spirits...! 

 *“Welcome to Yeongchunhwa, the secret mansion that will bring you infinite imagination. Here, any form of love is possible. Love and indulge freely. As long as the mansion permits.”* 

A luxurious mansion and the people who visit it for various reasons. Erotic stories for women, crafted by various authors, unfold now.

**Sixth Short Story \[Exclusive\] Exposing That Scoundrel's Debauchery!:** Reporter Jung Na-Hui, sent to Yeongchunhwa on a reward vacation after publishing an unverified article exposing the scandalous private life of rising star Kang Do-Hyuk. But as they say, enemies meet on a narrow bridge. Do-Hyuk, who has fallen from grace due to Na-Hui's article, also arrives at Yeongchunhwa, sent there as a hiding place. The two encounter each other at the mansion. But strangely, Do-Hyuk seems delighted to see Na-Hui? Amidst endless flirting, will Na-Hui be able to uncover his lewd and dissolute(?) true nature!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
